parameters.name: Intensity
parameters.desc: How much of the effect to apply, from 0 to 100.

parameters.name: Lighting
parameters.desc: How much lighting to apply, from 0 to 100.

parameters.name: Center X
parameters.desc: X position of the effect center, from 0 (left edge) to 100 (right edge).

parameters.name: Center Y
parameters.desc: Y position of the effect center, from 0 (bottom edge) to 100 (top edge).
